title: The Harvest Count That Doubled
central_conflict: the farmers' ledger showed twice as many crates as the barn could hold
decisive_choice: the clerk had entered both the original receipt and its carbon copy as separate loads
resolution: matched receipt numbers to real crates and corrected the public tally
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the farmers' ledger showed twice as many crates as the barn could hold during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they searched the road for missing deliveries but found none; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the clerk had entered both the original receipt and its carbon copy as separate loads; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they matched receipt numbers to real crates and corrected the public tally, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Puppet That Refused to Bow
central_conflict: the wooden puppet leaned backward whenever the finale called for a bow
decisive_choice: a heavy replacement hat moved the puppet's balance behind its shoulders
resolution: lightened the hat and adjusted the strings until the puppet bowed
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the wooden puppet leaned backward whenever the finale called for a bow during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they shortened its strings but it tipped backward even faster; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a heavy replacement hat moved the puppet's balance behind its shoulders; they planned a safer joint response.

title: The Costumes That Changed Color
central_conflict: the theater troupe arrived wearing costumes that seemed to be the wrong colors
decisive_choice: the new colored stage lights were hiding the dyes' appearance under white light
resolution: checked every outfit in neutral lighting and relabeled the costume rack
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the theater troupe arrived wearing costumes that seemed to be the wrong colors during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they swapped costumes backstage but the colors changed again on stage; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the new colored stage lights were hiding the dyes' appearance under white light; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they checked every outfit in neutral lighting and relabeled the costume rack, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
